## Open findings

### High (3)

- `analytics-prefs-disabled-rights-unexplained` — **AnalyticsPreferencesSection** — Disabled consent controls never say why they are disabled — `client/settings/sections/AnalyticsPreferencesSection.svelte:143`
- `analytics-prefs-failed-save-silently-reverts` — **AnalyticsPreferencesSection** — A failed preference save silently reverts the choice — `client/settings/sections/AnalyticsPreferencesSection.svelte:55`
- `analytics-prefs-radiogroup-unreachable-when-unset` — **AnalyticsPreferencesSection** — Both consent radiogroups are unreachable by keyboard until a choice already exists — `client/shared/ui/SegmentedControl.svelte:53`

### Med (10)

- `admin-users-live-region-mounts-with-text` — **AdminUsersSection** — Status and error regions mount with their announcement already inside them
- `analytics-prefs-bespoke-field-layout` — **AnalyticsPreferencesSection** — The section hand-rolls its own field layout instead of using `Field` — `client/settings/sections/AnalyticsPreferencesSection.svelte:135`
- `analytics-prefs-header-sub-and-refresh-unused` — **AnalyticsPreferencesSection** — The header's description and refresh slots go unused — `client/settings/sections/AnalyticsPreferencesSection.svelte:121`
- `analytics-prefs-live-regions-mount-with-text` — **AnalyticsPreferencesSection** — Status and error regions mount with their announcement already inside them — `client/settings/sections/AnalyticsPreferencesSection.svelte:184`
- `analytics-prefs-no-inflight-signal` — **AnalyticsPreferencesSection** — Async work is never signalled — `busy` only freezes the controls — `client/settings/sections/AnalyticsPreferencesSection.svelte:143`
- `analytics-prefs-raw-fetch-errors` — **AnalyticsPreferencesSection** — Error text bypasses the shared fetch-error formatter — `client/settings/sections/AnalyticsPreferencesSection.svelte:33`
- `analytics-prefs-raw-status-enum-copy` — **AnalyticsPreferencesSection** — Raw status enums and transport errors reach the user — `client/settings/sections/AnalyticsPreferencesSection.svelte:102`
- `analytics-prefs-unknown-state-unlabelled` — **AnalyticsPreferencesSection** — The unrecorded-choice state is never named — `client/settings/sections/AnalyticsPreferencesSection.svelte:109`
- `plugins-inactive-copy-overclaims-approval` — **PluginsSection** — The ineligible-plugin sentence names approval as the remedy for six different states — `client/settings/lib/plugin-eligibility.ts:44`
- `transcript-aria-live-history-race` — **TranscriptApp** — The history bulk-load can be announced as if it were live

### Low (8)

- `analytics-prefs-duplicate-aria-naming` — **AnalyticsPreferencesSection** — Both radiogroups are announced twice under the same name — `client/settings/sections/AnalyticsPreferencesSection.svelte:140`
- `analytics-prefs-effective-timestamp-raw-locale` — **AnalyticsPreferencesSection** — The effective-since timestamp is a raw full locale string — `client/settings/sections/AnalyticsPreferencesSection.svelte:112`
- `analytics-prefs-export-not-rights-gated` — **AnalyticsPreferencesSection** — Export is not gated by subject-rights availability while the other rights are — `client/settings/sections/AnalyticsPreferencesSection.svelte:162`
- `analytics-prefs-field-row-unbounded-width` — **AnalyticsPreferencesSection** — The control detaches to the far edge on wide viewports — `client/settings/sections/AnalyticsPreferencesSection.svelte:226`
- `analytics-prefs-off-scale-spacing-and-type` — **AnalyticsPreferencesSection** — Spacing and type values drift off the shared scale — `client/settings/sections/AnalyticsPreferencesSection.svelte:229`
- `coding-mcp-live-region-mounts-with-text` — **CodingMcpSection** — Status and error regions mount with their announcement already inside them — `client/settings/sections/CodingMcpSection.svelte:178`
- `settings-app-focus-ring-scoped-to-grid` — **SettingsApp** — The focus ring's colour is a hardcoded literal instead of the accent token — `client/shared/tokens.css:39`
- `settings-app-jump-menu-ignores-collapse` — **SettingsApp** — Re-picking the jump menu's current section does nothing

## Deferred

- `repos-no-edit-capability` — **ReposSection** — A repository can only be added or deleted, never edited
- `settings-app-no-shared-type-scale` — **SettingsApp** — No shared type scale, so every component invents its own font sizes
